outcome: PISQ-IR subscores (Condition Impact, Condition-Specific, Global Quality, Partner-Related, Arousal)
cohort: 2106 women up to 24 months postpartum, recruited via social media.
finding: Impairments in female sexual functioning persist for an extended period after childbirth, with 21% of women not sexually active even 12-24 months postpartum and perineal tears significantly associated with lower PISQ-IR subscores.
mod_finding: Differences in female sexual functioning related to mode of delivery were evident in specific PISQ-IR dimensions, with forceps or vacuum extraction associated with more impairments in 'Condition Impact' and 'Condition Specific' subscores up to 12 months postpartum.
